# 03-validate: Validate solution build and run test suite

## Objective

Perform final validation of the fully upgraded solution. Run a complete solution build to confirm zero errors and no warnings in upgraded projects. Then execute the unit test suite to confirm functional correctness.

## Research Findings

### Projects Affected
All 10 projects (build validation). Primary test project: UnitTests.

### Done-When Criteria
1. Solution builds with 0 errors
2. All unit tests pass (UnitTests project)
3. No compiler warnings in touched projects

## Validation Results

- **Build**: 0 errors, 0 compiler warnings ✅
- **Unit Tests**: 44/44 passed ✅
